# Components: Actions

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from Generated/*.razor, blazor/mappings, generated.manifest.json and core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every generated component also renders its element with the attributes you set; it accepts only the parameters listed (an unlisted attribute such as `class` throws when the component renders, so put classes on a wrapping element). Names are `Pk` plus the tag in PascalCase.

## `PkButton`

`<pk-button>`: **Button** (Actions). A button in five variants and three sizes, with busy, icon-only and toggle forms. type="submit" and "reset" act on the surrounding form, as a native button does.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Variant` | `ButtonVariant?` | `Primary` `Ghost` `Warn` `Secondary` `Plain` | attribute `variant` | Visual weight. |
| `Size` | `ButtonSize?` | `Md` `Mini` `Lg` | attribute `size` | md is the reading-size control; mini is the compact desktop-density one; lg is the large one. |
| `Type` | `string?` |  | attribute `type` | What a click does inside a form: nothing, submit it, or reset it. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` |  | attribute `disabled` | Blocks interaction and dims the control. Also set by a disabled fieldset. |
| `Busy` | `bool` |  | attribute `busy` | Shows a spinner and ignores clicks without disabling the button, so focus stays put. |
| `BusyText` | `string?` |  | attribute `busy-text` | Replaces the label while busy. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` |  | attribute `label` | An accessible name when the visible content is only an icon. |
| `Block` | `bool` |  | attribute `block` | Fills the width of its container. |
| `Icon` | `bool` |  | attribute `icon` | A square icon-only button (give it a label). |
| `Toggle` | `bool` |  | attribute `toggle` | A button that stays pressed: a click flips pressed. |
| `Pressed` | `bool` |  | attribute `pressed` | The pressed state of a toggle button. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` |  | event `click` | A click (not fired while disabled or busy). |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | The label. |
| `StartContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `start` | An icon before the label. |
| `EndContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `end` | An icon after the label. |

When you set a named fragment (`StartContent`, `EndContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

## `PkButtonGroup`

`<pk-button-group>`: **Button group** (Actions). Buttons fused into one bar, horizontal, vertical or full width; with mode="single" its toggle buttons behave as one choice, which makes it the SDK's segmented control (a Dark/Light switch, a view or density picker).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Orientation` | `string?` |  | attribute `orientation` | Direction of the bar. |
| `Fill` | `bool` |  | attribute `fill` | Fills the container width and shares it between the buttons. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` |  | attribute `label` | Accessible name of the group (aria-label). |
| `Mode` | `string?` |  | attribute `mode` | single: the toggle buttons in the group release each other (one is always pressed); multi and none leave each toggle alone. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | pk-button elements. |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-button-group` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.

## `PkSplitButton`

`<pk-split-button>`: **Split button** (Actions). A main action beside a caret that opens a menu of related actions, so the common case is one click and the variants stay reachable.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Variant` | `string?` |  | attribute `variant` | Colour of both halves. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` |  | attribute `disabled` | Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset. |
| `ToggleLabel` | `string?` |  | attribute `toggle-label` | Accessible name of the caret button. |
| `Open` | `bool` |  | attribute `open` | Whether the menu is open. |
| `MenuAlign` | `string?` |  | attribute `menu-align` | Which edge the menu lines up with. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` |  | event `click` | The main action was clicked. |
| `OnSelect` | `EventCallback<PkSplitSelectEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-split-select` | A menu item was chosen. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | The main action label. |
| `MenuContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `menu` | The menu items: buttons (with a value or data-value). |

When you set a named fragment (`MenuContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-split-select` | `PkSplitSelectEventArgs` | Value: string?, Label: string? |
